status_basis: met means corresponding implementation appears in the reviewed diff; it does not clear findings or unexecuted acceptance gates.

requirements.note: Independent bundle identity and trusted sandbox root; no old-store discovery or migration.
Separate Go build/verify scripts and preview documentation preserve the Swift tree; caller reports Swift build passed.
Members, system chooser, bounded original copy, and PDF/JPEG/PNG/HEIC/single-frame TIFF paths exist. HEIC and File Provider manual coverage remain pending.
Production PDFKit/Vision extraction persists source-linked results; signed-app PDF and transparent-PNG flows passed per caller. Scanned-PDF branch coverage is finding #5.
Preview, manual date, review save, member-gated confirmation, and dirty save/discard/cancel are implemented and covered; shutdown while busy remains finding #2.
Queries require confirmed status and selected member and search corrected text; native integration and caller UI evidence cover isolation.
Durable reopen, interrupted-draft recovery, serialized mutations, and late-result rejection are present. Empty-library initialization recovery is finding #1.
Extraction stays separate from Review; page, bounds, method, and engine survive save/confirm/reopen and remain visible.
Shared byte/page/image/text budgets and typed failures are enforced. Valid oversized-image guard coverage and scanned-PDF coverage need strengthening.
Preview entitlements allow sandbox and selected-file read only; storage and privacy docs describe plaintext and hash limits.
Chinese/English semantic resources, runtime language persistence, and localized labels exist; language-change state is tested. VoiceOver effectiveness remains unverified.
Fixtures and runtime acceptance use synthetic material; preview docs distinguish current-Mac results from IME, accessibility, architecture, OS, and distribution gates.
